lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five distinct horizontal rows with increasing spatial separation as they progress posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of high-contrast nodes most prominent in the anterior-mid flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge to localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance biological features (remoras) positioned near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
